answer: A payout is split and therefore 24% arrives at settlement and the rest over 13 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The garden schedule is applied in spiral and atlas shows each instalment. Someone therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4516 identities would post 3751 proofs and burn roughly 25 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
